title: Colours
label: ch:ta-colours
canDo: I can name black, white, red, and blue in Tamil and say which three are native and which one is the Sanskrit loan.

payoff.summary: Say karuppu, veḷḷai and sivappu as the native three, nīlam as the borrowed one, and hear veḷḷai echo veḷḷi from last chapter.
